title: Google Compute Engine Instance Group Manager

operations.description: Deletes the instance group manager and all instances contained within. If you'd like to delete the manager without deleting the instances, you must first abandon the instances to remove them from the group.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] replicapool instance group managers delete [PATH] zones instance group managers [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieves the list of Instance Group Manager resources contained within the specified zone.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replicapool instance group managers list [PATH] zones instance group managers [PARAMS] alt fields filter ip key max oauth page pretty print project quota results token user zone [SCHEMA] auto group healing instance list manager policy pool replica

operations.description: Returns the specified Instance Group Manager resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replicapool instance group managers [PATH] zones instance group managers [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] auto group healing instance manager policy pool replica

operations.description: Retrieves the list of operation resources contained within the specified zone.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replicapool zone operations list [PATH] zones operations [PARAMS] alt fields filter ip key max oauth page pretty print project quota results token user zone [SCHEMA] list operation

operations.description: Retrieves the specified zone-specific operation resource.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replicapool zone operations [PATH] zones operations [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth operation pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Creates an instance group manager, as well as the instance group and the specified number of instances.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers insert [PATH] zones instance group managers [PARAMS] alt fields ip key oauth pretty print project quota size token user zone [SCHEMA] auto group healing instance manager policy pool replica

operations.description: Removes the specified instances from the managed instance group, and from any target pools of which they were members, without deleting the instances.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers abandon instances [PATH] zones instance group managers abandon instances [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] abandon group instance instances managers request

operations.description: Deletes the specified instances. The instances are deleted, then removed from the instance group and any target pools of which they were a member. The targetSize of the instance group manager is reduced by the number of instances deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers delete instances [PATH] zones instance group managers delete instances [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] delete group instance instances managers request

operations.description: Recreates the specified instances. The instances are deleted, then recreated using the instance group manager's current instance template.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers recreate instances [PATH] zones instance group managers recreate instances [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] group instance instances managers recreate request

operations.description: Resizes the managed instance group up or down. If resized up, new instances are created using the current instance template. If resized down, instances are removed in the order outlined in Resizing a managed instance group.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers resize [PATH] zones instance group managers resize [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota size token user zone [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Sets the instance template to use when creating new instances in this group. Existing instances are not affected.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers set instance template [PATH] zones instance group managers set instance template [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] group instance managers request set template

operations.description: Modifies the target pools to which all new instances in this group are assigned. Existing instances in the group are not affected.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] replicapool instance group managers set target pools [PATH] zones instance group managers set target pools [PARAMS] alt fields group instance ip key manager oauth pretty print project quota token user zone [SCHEMA] group instance managers pools request set target
